$comment: INVERSION 2. The enforcement API fails open on a timeout (QUARANTINE with effective_verdict PASS) because a human reviews the order before fulfillment. An agent has no such backstop, so a timeout is not a verdict at all. Note checks_performed is EMPTY: nothing was evaluated.

next_actions.description: A dependency did not answer in time. No checks completed.

agent_may_say: I couldn't check that just now — let me try again.
agent_must_not_say: ANYTHING about eligibility. This is an outage, not an answer. Rendering it as 'this wine can't ship to you' invents a legal conclusion out of a failed dependency.
